photoIntelligence.photoOnlyInterpretation: Across 35 days, the back-view comparison shows a major overall visual improvement after calibrated multi-region magnitude reconciliation. The strongest changes are a substantially tighter lower back and waist, clearer definition across the upper back, rear delts, lats, and triceps, and a much stronger back-to-waist taper. Different elbow height and scapular positioning make back-width and lat-size claims unreliable, but they do not erase the broad conditioning change. The result strongly supports progress toward Visible Abs without quantifying fat loss, muscle change, or causation.
photoIntelligence.exactPhotoBriefingCopy: Your cut is showing clearly from the back. By July, your waist and lower back look noticeably tighter, and there is much more separation through your upper back, rear shoulders, lats, and triceps. That gives you a substantially stronger taper from shoulders to waist and is a major visual step toward Visible Abs. The higher elbow position changes how wide the back can look, so these photos do not prove lat growth—but the improvement in conditioning and overall shape is clear.
